questions.prompt: The atomic number of an element is equivalent to the number of
questions.explanation: Atomic number is the number of protons.

questions.prompt: Which of the following has a positive charge?
Which of the following is found in a different area of the atom than the others
questions.explanation: Electrons occupy regions around the nucleus; protons and neutrons are in the nucleus.

options: an atom with more neutrons than electrons
an atom with the same number of protons and electrons
an atom with different numbers of protons and electrons
questions.explanation: An atomic ion has unequal proton and electron counts and therefore net charge.

options: in group 5 of the periodic table
elements joined together by carbon bonds
questions.explanation: A is the intended broad description: organic chemistry concerns carbon-based molecular frameworks, often with C–H bonds. Not every carbon-containing substance is classified as organic.

questions.prompt: The best description for a molecule is
options: elements of the same type chemically joined together
more than one atom chemically joined
elements of different types chemically bonded
questions.explanation: B is closest: a molecule is a discrete group of two or more chemically bonded atoms. They may be the same element or different elements.
